# Event Contract, FROZEN

Every UI connects to a single websocket and filters events by `type`.

**Endpoint:** `ws://<BRAIN_IP>:8765`

During development, run `contract/mock_server.py` locally and connect to `ws://localhost:8765`.
On demo day, change only the IP. Nothing else changes.

**Do not edit this file without announcing it to the whole team.** Every UI depends on it.

---

## Event types

### round_start
Emitted when a federated round begins.
```json
{"type":"round_start","round":3,"total_rounds":15,"clients":["hosp_a","hosp_b","hosp_c"]}
```

### client_training
Emitted repeatedly while a client trains locally. Use for progress bars.
```json
{"type":"client_training","client":"hosp_a","samples":412,"progress":0.4,"local_loss":0.83}
```

### client_update
Emitted when a client finishes and sends its weights. `images_sent` is always 0 and must be displayed prominently.
```json
{"type":"client_update","client":"hosp_a","bytes":184320,"images_sent":0,"payload_type":"model_weights"}
```

### aggregate
Emitted after the server aggregates the round.
```json
{"type":"aggregate","round":3,"global_acc":0.71,"per_client_acc":{"hosp_a":0.69,"hosp_b":0.74,"hosp_c":0.68},"strategy":"FedProx"}
```

### privacy
Emitted once per round with the running privacy budget.
```json
{"type":"privacy","round":3,"epsilon":2.4,"delta":1e-5,"dp_enabled":true,"noise_multiplier":1.1,"clip_norm":1.0}
```

### intercept
Emitted when the attacker console captures a payload.
```json
{"type":"intercept","round":3,"client":"hosp_a","payload_kb":180,"dp_enabled":false}
```

### surveillance
Emitted per district when aggregate case counts update.
```json
{"type":"surveillance","district":"Chennai","cases":142,"severity_high":31,"noised":true}
```

### client_dropout
Emitted if a node goes offline mid-round. Used for the resilience moment.
```json
{"type":"client_dropout","client":"hosp_c","round":7}
```

---

## Client IDs, fixed

| ID | Display name | Data skew |
|---|---|---|
| `hosp_a` | Apollo Referral Centre, Chennai | severe cases, grades 3 and 4 over-represented |
| `hosp_b` | Rural Screening Camp, Coimbatore | mild and healthy, grades 0 and 1 over-represented |
| `hosp_c` | District Hospital, Madurai | mixed grades, degraded image quality |

## Colour tokens, use these across all UIs

| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| bg | `#0B0E14` | background |
| surface | `#151A24` | cards |
| text | `#E6EAF2` | primary text |
| muted | `#7A8699` | secondary text |
| safe | `#2ECC71` | privacy on, images sent 0 |
| danger | `#FF4D4D` | attack succeeded, privacy off |
| accent | `#4D8DFF` | active training, links |
| warn | `#FFB020` | epsilon budget warnings |
